summary: End-to-end testing of new Sales / POS (Penjualan) module — backend 14/14 pytest passed, frontend full flow verified (nav → 4 stat cards → new sale modal with items/material picker/auto-subtotal → payment summary → save → receipt window (thermal 80mm) → row appears → print button re-opens receipt → delete with stock rollback).

issues: Known devtool-injected hydration warning: <span> auto-wrapped inside <option> for material dropdown (activeMats loop at Sales.jsx L272). Same class of issue previously reported in iteration_14 for Purchasing selects — appears to be Emergent devtool wrapping option children with data-ve-dynamic span. Not user-facing but pollutes console.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _next_sale_no counts documents whose sale_no matches today's prefix, then appends count+1. Race condition possible under concurrent POST /api/sales (two simultaneous requests can compute same next number). For a single-cashier scenario acceptable, but consider find_one_and_update on a per-day counter document if concurrency expands.

server.py sales_create decrements stock in a second loop AFTER inserting the sale doc. If the update_one fails midway (e.g., DB disconnect), the sale is saved but stock isn't fully decremented — no transactional guarantee. Consider Mongo transactions/atomic $inc, or roll stock updates inline with validation.
server.py Sales endpoints require_super_admin only. The spec mentions 'kasir' role — if separate cashier role is added later, adjust guard (currently only super_admin can access POS).
server.py sales_create stock check compares area_total > current_stock strictly. If current_stock == 0 and area_total == 0, passes validation (already blocked earlier by len/width>0 guard). OK.

server.py 4408-4700 Sales section is ~290 lines appended to a 4700-line server.py file. server.py has surpassed maintainable-single-file size long ago; consider splitting modules (inventory, purchasing, sales, payroll…) into routers per file.
Frontend Sales.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete — inconsistent with rest of app if it uses shadcn AlertDialog. Minor UX consistency issue.

Frontend Sales.jsx receipt window is opened via window.open with query ?auto=1 which auto-triggers print. In some browsers popup blockers may silently block; consider a fallback (inline preview) when window is null.
